mainText: This is Dose of Good for Saturday, November 7. Here are 5 good news stories. First: 13-year-old girl saves a baby who fell into a fish tank. Luiza Lemanski Colella gave first aid to a 15-month-old in Sorriso, Mato Grosso. She learned the techniques in a firefighters' youth project, and the baby is out of danger. Second: Public-school student from Bahia wins science fair with sustainable cement. Thiago Santos Ferreira, 18, won Mostratec 2026 with a biocement made from recycled paper and coconut fibre. He earned a spot at the Regeneron ISEF in Los Angeles in 2027. Third: Man uses a rope to save an elderly horse swept away by a river. Felipe Alves held on to his horse Sancho in a flooded river after heavy rain in Santa Catarina. Three other men came with ropes and pulled him out. The horse is fine. Fourth: Brazil is the only country with 3 people among the world's 10 oldest. According to LongeviQuest, Yolanda Beltrão de Azevedo (115, Maceió), Beatriz Ferreira Duarte (115, Jaboatão dos Guararapes) and João Marinho Neto (114, Ceará) are on the list. All are from the Northeast. Fifth: Geothermal heat comes to affordable housing in the US. A 44-unit affordable housing project in Hinesburg, Vermont, will get geothermal heating and cooling. In a government case study, it cut energy costs by 40%. That was your dose for today. See you tomorrow!
